Hi Frieder,

Thanks for checking in, and sorry you are still waiting on this one.

Order Shop···· is paid and still showing as unshipped. It is the Bitfortun BS-4 (22 TH/s), which ships direct from the manufacturer rather than from our warehouse. The date on your order was September 12, and we wrote to you on September 11 to say the BS-4 had gone live before the drop launched, that we were honouring your order at the price you paid, and that it would go out with the launch batch on a longer lead time than usual. Our mail sometimes lands in junk, so it is worth adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts so the shipping notice reaches you.

What I do not want to do is give you a date I cannot stand behind, and the order carries no revised one. I have put this in front of a colleague to get the current ship date from the manufacturer. The team is offline right now and picks it up today at 10am Eastern, and the answer comes to you by email in this thread, so there is nothing more you need to send.

Thanks for your patience with it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
